test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_u64_left_{card} (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE test_u64_right_{card} (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_u64_left_{card} SELECT number % {card} FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO test_u64_right_{card} SELECT number FROM numbers({card})
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_u64_left_{card} FINAL
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_u64_right_{card} FINAL

CREATE TABLE test_str_right (k String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k

INSERT INTO test_str_right SELECT toString(number) FROM numbers(100)
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_str_left FINAL
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_str_right FINAL

test.create_query: CREATE TABLE fsm_str_sparse_left (k String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE fsm_str_sparse_right (k String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k

INSERT INTO fsm_str_sparse_right SELECT leftPad(toString(number * 100), 12, '0') FROM numbers(50000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE fsm_str_sparse_left FINAL
OPTIMIZE TABLE fsm_str_sparse_right FINAL
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE fsm_nullable_left (k Nullable(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE fsm_nullable_right (k Nullable(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO fsm_nullable_left SELECT if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO fsm_nullable_right SELECT if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, number * 100 + 1) FROM numbers(100000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE fsm_nullable_left FINAL
OPTIMIZE TABLE fsm_nullable_right FINAL
